caption: The video captures a man in a black sleeveless ZUMBA shirt seen from behind in a dance studio, facing a wall mirror that reflects his front and a child in a yellow top also raising her arms. He is mid-routine, cycling his arms through a repeating pattern in which one arm sweeps out to the side while the opposite elbow tucks near his head. Both arms then lift into a wide overhead V before lowering again, alternating left and right across the excerpt. His torso sways and rotates slightly as his weight shifts between legs, with heels lifting and feet stepping in a rhythmic groove. The mirror shows his reflection moving in exact sync with each arm spread and overhead raise. The room's fixed layout—the whiteboard panel, wall clock and floor bags—stays unchanged, while a reflected figure in teal drifts into view on the left. The arm cycle continues through the final frame without resolving into a resting pose.
